algorithms.title: HazMat Approach (EMS Awareness/Operations)
steps: Stop upwind, uphill, upstream; use binoculars.
Identify: placard class + UN number → ERG (yellow/blue → orange guide → green distances).
Isolate & deny entry; set hot/warm/cold zones.
Notify: METHANE + HazMat team + hospitals (contaminated patients may self-present).
Instruct exposed ambulatory people by PA: move upwind, remove outer clothing.
Receive patients in the cold zone after decon; treat per toxidrome (Chapter 10).

algorithms.title: Mass Decontamination
steps: Disrobe (outer clothing at least) — bag, tag, keep valuables with the person.
Triage for decon priority: symptomatic, visible liquid, non-ambulatory first.
Dry decon (blot/wipe exposed skin) for most; wet decon for caustics, visible liquid, symptoms.
Wet decon: high-volume, low-pressure lukewarm water, ~30–60 s+ per person, head to toe; no scrubbing.
Non-ambulatory lane: decon teams roll/wash on backboards/litters.
Re-dress (gowns/blankets), keep warm, triage in the cold zone, document decon on the tag.
